from typing import assert_type
import torch
from townlet.exploration.rng_custody import AmbientRNGDomain, RNGParticipant, RNGOperation, RNGAdmission, LocalCUDAContract, LocalCUDAGate

def check_public(domain: AmbientRNGDomain, participant: RNGParticipant, lineage: RNGOperation | None, contract: LocalCUDAContract, device: torch.device, devices: tuple[int, ...], error: BaseException) -> None:
    with domain.operation(participant=participant, operation_kind="ordinary", lineage=lineage) as operation:
        assert_type(operation, RNGOperation)
    with domain.device_operation(participant=participant, operation_kind="ordinary", lineage=lineage, cuda_devices=devices) as operation:
        assert_type(operation, RNGOperation)
    with domain.admission(lineage=lineage) as admission:
        assert_type(admission, RNGAdmission)
        assert_type(admission.resolve_cuda(device), int)
        assert_type(admission.enroll(participant=participant, cuda_devices=devices), None)
        assert_type(admission.report_failure(error=error), None)
    with domain.local_cuda_access(participant=participant, contract=contract) as local:
        assert_type(local, LocalCUDAGate)
        assert_type(local.resolve_cuda(device=device), int)
        with local.complete(cuda_devices=devices) as completed:
            assert_type(completed, None)
        assert_type(local.completion_failed(), bool)
        assert_type(local.report_failure(error=error), None)

from typing import assert_type
import torch
from townlet.exploration.rng_custody import AmbientRNGDomain, RNGParticipant, RNGOperation, RNGAdmission, LocalCUDAContract, LocalCUDAGate

def check_public(domain: AmbientRNGDomain, participant: RNGParticipant, lineage: RNGOperation | None, contract: LocalCUDAContract, device: torch.device, devices: tuple[int, ...], error: BaseException) -> None:
    with domain.operation(participant=participant, operation_kind="ordinary", lineage=lineage) as operation:
        assert_type(operation, RNGOperation)
    with domain.device_operation(participant=participant, operation_kind="ordinary", lineage=lineage, cuda_devices=devices) as operation:
        assert_type(operation, RNGOperation)
    with domain.admission(lineage=lineage) as admission:
        assert_type(admission, RNGAdmission)
        assert_type(admission.resolve_cuda(device), int)
        assert_type(admission.enroll(participant=participant, cuda_devices=devices), None)
        assert_type(admission.report_failure(error=error), None)
    with domain.local_cuda_access(participant=participant, contract=contract) as local:
        assert_type(local, LocalCUDAGate)
        assert_type(local.resolve_cuda(device=device), int)
        with local.complete(cuda_devices=devices) as completed:
            assert_type(completed, None)
        assert_type(local.completion_failed(), bool)
        assert_type(local.report_failure(error=error), None)
